baseline.label: superpowers only
baseline.instruction: Use the superpowers workflow end to end: `superpowers:brainstorming` (design), `superpowers:writing-plans` (plan under temp/plans/), `superpowers:subagent-driven-development` (implement, test and review each task with subagents), then `superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch` choosing to keep the branch as it is.

plugin.label: agentic-sdd-flow
plugin.instruction: Use the plugin entry point `/agentic-sdd-flow:dotnet-feature <TASK-KEY> <title>` end to end (design → plan → dotnet-sdd workflow → branch). When a proposal or a spec is presented for approval, approve the recommended one and continue; when the workflow returns `plan_rejected`, fix the plan from its findings and rerun it with `resumeFromRunId`; when it returns open questions, answer them with the most conservative reading of the criteria and rerun.
